user.title: Choose your soundbar
user.description: Uses your existing SmartThings connection. No extra login or token is needed.

features.title: Choose advanced audio controls
features.description: Enable settings your soundbar supports in the SmartThings app. HW-Q930D also offers sound modes and individual speaker levels. These controls remember the last accepted command; they cannot detect remote or app changes. Source controls are added when advertised by the device.

error.device_unavailable: This soundbar is no longer available. Check SmartThings and try again.

abort.no_soundbars: No compatible soundbars found. Set up the built-in SmartThings integration first and check that your soundbar is available.
abort.invalid_settings: An unsupported audio setting was selected.
abort.not_supported: This device is not set up from discovery. Add the soundbar through the SmartThings Soundbar Extras integration instead.

init.title: Local API
init.description: Optionally also connect to the soundbar over your local network (Samsung IP Control). This adds the audio codec, direct input and sound-mode control, and real readback. SmartThings controls keep working either way. IP control must be enabled in the SmartThings app under the soundbar's settings.

local.title: Local API connection
local.description: Choose the soundbar's address. Soundbars found on your network are listed; you can also type an IP address.

confirm.title: Trust this soundbar?
confirm.description:
Connected to **{identifier}**.

Its certificate fingerprint is:
`{fingerprint}`

The local API will only talk to a device presenting this exact certificate.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the soundbar at this address.
error.ip_control_disabled: The soundbar refused the connection. Enable IP control in the SmartThings app and try again.
error.not_a_soundbar: The device at this address is not a Samsung soundbar.

set.name: Set advanced audio
set.description: Send an advanced audio setting. Prefer the native switch entities for automations.

device_id.name: SmartThings device ID
device_id.description: Required when more than one soundbar is configured.

certificate_changed.title: {name}: soundbar certificate changed
certificate_changed.description: The soundbar's local API presented a different certificate than the one trusted when the local API was set up. This can follow a firmware update or factory reset, or mean that a different device now uses this address. The local entities are unavailable until you trust the new certificate: open the integration entry, choose **Configure**, and save the local API settings again. SmartThings controls are not affected.

local_unreachable.title: {name}: local API unreachable
local_unreachable.description: SmartThings reports the soundbar as online, but its local API at {host} has not answered for 30 minutes. Check that the address is still correct and that IP control is enabled in the SmartThings app, then save the local API settings again under **Configure**. SmartThings controls are not affected.

parent_removed.message: The SmartThings integration this soundbar was set up with no longer exists. Remove this entry and add the soundbar again.

parent_not_loaded.message: The SmartThings integration or this soundbar is not loaded yet.

smartthings_unavailable.message: The soundbar or its SmartThings connection is unavailable.

command_failed.message: SmartThings did not confirm command acceptance. The assumed state has not been changed.

choose_device.message: Select one configured soundbar using its SmartThings device ID.

setting_disabled.message: This audio control is not enabled for this soundbar.

invalid_sound_mode.message: Choose Standard, Surround, Game Pro, or Adaptive Sound.

invalid_level.message: Choose a whole-number speaker level from -6 to +6 dB.
